title: Couch: TV Remote
shortDescription: Keep everyday TV controls together on your home Wi-Fi.
fullDescription:
Find supported TVs on your local network and keep everyday remote controls together. Save your TVs, switch between them and use a clear control layout. Every TV control and theme is free.

Compatibility varies by TV and connection. Your phone and TV must be reachable on the same network. Infrared requires a phone with a compatible emitter.
